home.noTeams: No teams yet. Create one and the project manager and members will collaborate here.
home.emptyTitle: Hand one job to a whole team
home.emptyBody: Pick a working folder and CoBot sets up a project manager and members for it. Tell the project manager your goal; it splits the work into tasks for the members, and asks you before anyone runs a command or edits a file.
home.pickTitle: Who do you want to talk to?
home.selectBot: Pick a member on the left, or go straight to a project manager.

avatar.pictureNote: Local picture: kept on this computer only
avatar.pictureType: Only PNG, JPEG or WebP pictures are supported.
avatar.pictureUnreadable: This picture could not be read. Try another one.
avatar.pictureTooLarge: This picture is still too large after resizing. Try one with less detail.
avatar.noCatalog: The avatar catalog has not been downloaded yet, so avatars cannot be changed. Check for updates in Settings > Appearance.

archived.restored: “{{name}}” is restored and back in the team list
archived.deleteBody: Their members, conversations, tasks, memories, Codex sessions and the .cobot folder in the project are permanently removed. This cannot be undone. Other project files are not touched.

team.directoryNested: Nested with the directory of team {{teamName}}
team.archiveConfirmBody: The team moves from the team list to Settings › Archived teams, its Codex process stops, and it keeps its folder. Conversations and data stay; you can restore it at any time.
team.deleteMissingConfirmBody: The team's project folder is no longer where it was. Deleting permanently removes its members, conversations, tasks, memories and Codex sessions, including any unfinished work. This cannot be undone.
team.deleteMemberConfirmBody: Its conversation, memories, runs, the finished tasks it owned and its Codex session in this team are permanently removed. This cannot be undone. Messages it sent to other members stay. The role itself is not affected and stays available to other teams.
team.directoryFixed: A team's folder cannot change after creation.
team.membersLocked: Existing members cannot be changed here; tick new roles to add them.
team.directoryArchived: This folder belongs to the archived team “{{teamName}}”. Restore that team to keep using it.
team.directoryClaimed: This folder is already used by team “{{teamName}}”; a new team cannot be created here
team.directoryClaimedUnknown: This folder is already used by a team in another CoBot environment; a new team cannot be created here
team.directoryPlaceholder: or paste the folder's full path
team.name: Team name

leader.name: Project manager
leader.summary: Talks the need through with you, writes the requirement document, drafts the route and reports back at the end.

productManager.name: Product manager
productManager.summary: Turns the requirement document into a product design and prototype.

fullstackEngineer.name: Full-stack engineer
fullstackEngineer.summary: Builds the interface, interactions, server logic and data.

qaEngineer.name: QA engineer
qaEngineer.summary: Writes test cases and runs the tests, sending failures back.

codeReviewer.name: Reviewer
codeReviewer.summary: Reviews requirements, designs, test cases and code against the checklist; a failing review sends the work back.

stats.estimateNote: First token is estimated from each turn's start to its first step; speed is output tokens over model time.
stats.contextNote: From the tokens of the last model call; Codex does not break it down into system prompt, tools and conversation.

effort.label: Reasoning effort
effort.note: Applies from each member's next turn. Higher effort thinks more, takes longer and uses more.
effort.modelNote: The model is the default model all teams share.

hint.read_only: Can look and analyse; asks before changing anything
hint.default: Free to read, write and run inside the team folder; asks beyond it
hint.full: Never asks; not limited to the team folder

confirmFull.title: Switch to full access?
confirmFull.body: Members will run any command and change any file without asking, beyond the team folder and network limits. Applies from each member's next turn.

conversation.emptyLeader: Tell the project manager what you want done. It agrees a plan with you first and assigns members once you confirm.
conversation.emptyMember: Members usually get work from the project manager. You can also ask this member a question or add details here.

settings.authorizationsHint: Member bridge credentials (token values never shown); revoking invalidates the next bridge call immediately
settings.title: Settings
settings.modelsNeedEngine: Models can be chosen once Codex is available; see Codex engine first.
settings.defaultModelHint: The model members use for their work.

sectionHints.general: Basic preferences such as the interface language.
sectionHints.appearance: Light, dark or following the system, and the interface colors. Members keep their role colors in every theme.
sectionHints.roles: Each role's default avatar. Members without an avatar of their own follow it; click a member's avatar in its conversation to change just that member.
sectionHints.engine: CoBot detects Codex and authorizes its safety hook at startup; this page shows the result.
sectionHints.models: Changes apply right away to work that starts afterwards.
sectionHints.collaboration: Team size, how often members may wake each other, and usage budget.
sectionHints.archived: Archived teams leave the team list; restore them or delete them for good here.
sectionHints.security: Bridge authorizations members currently hold; revoke them at any time.
sectionHints.about: Version and where data is stored on this machine.
